description: This Java class implements an immutable version of a JSON Web Token (JWT), providing methods to create tokens from authorization headers or token strings, and overriding equality, hash, and string representation methods.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebToken
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JsonWebToken for standard JSON Web Tokens, providing token parsing and subject retrieval.

methods.name: fromAuthorization
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonWebToken from an authorization header string.

methods.name: getTokenFromAuthorizationString
methods.description: Extracts the token part from an authorization header string, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: fromToken
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonWebToken from a token string.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of subjects associated with the token.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on token content and subjects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on token and subjects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token including subjects.
